title: Ghostty 1.4
summary:
Ghostty 1.4, released October 27, 2026, is a major update introducing substantial performance and memory enhancements, a complete Kitty graphics implementation, improved SSH integration, and hundreds of other fixes across platforms. Developed by 172 contributors over seven months, the release prioritizes security, addressing numerous vulnerabilities including paste protection bypasses, malicious graphics command exploits, tmux control mode crashes, and macOS-specific unsafe hyperlink and drag-and-drop issues.

Key highlights include full macOS 27 support with compatibility fixes and visual improvements, and the completion of Kitty graphics animation and relative placements, making Ghostty the first non-Kitty terminal to achieve 100% spec coverage with significant speed improvements. Memory usage is reduced through transparent scrollback compression (70-90% savings), allowing a default scrollback limit increase from 10MB to 50MB, and optimized GPU resource handling for hidden tabs.

Performance sees major gains: 25-55% faster I/O on macOS, 5.7x faster ASCII VT parsing, 6x faster resizing, and 15% faster launch. Linux and FreeBSD benefit from a new OpenGL renderer, delivering crisp text with fractional scaling and reduced tearing. Ghostty 1.4 also implements the Kitty clipboard protocol (OSC 5522) for rich data handling, brings split drag-and-drop to GTK, and significantly improves terminal emulation accuracy, now passing the esctest conformance suite. SSH integration is enhanced with the new `ghostty +ssh` CLI, providing reliable terminfo installation and environment forwarding.
chinese_title: Ghostty 1.4
chinese_summary:
Ghostty 1.4 于 2026 年 10 月 27 日发布，是一次重大更新，带来了显著的性能和内存增强、完整的 Kitty 图形实现、改进的 SSH 集成以及数百项跨平台修复。该版本由 172 名贡献者历时七个月开发，优先考虑安全性，解决了大量漏洞，包括粘贴保护绕过、恶意图形命令利用、tmux 控制模式崩溃以及 macOS 特有的不安全超链接和拖放问题。

主要亮点包括完全支持 macOS 27，并提供了兼容性修复和视觉改进；完成了 Kitty 图形动画和相对定位的实现，使 Ghostty 成为首个非 Kitty 终端，以显著的速度提升达到了 100% 的规范覆盖率。内存使用通过透明的回滚压缩（节省 70-90%）得以减少，这使得默认回滚限制从 10MB 增加到 50MB，并优化了隐藏标签页的 GPU 资源处理。

性能方面取得了显著提升：macOS 上的 I/O 速度提高 25-55%，ASCII VT 解析速度提高 5.7 倍，调整大小速度提高 6 倍，启动速度提高 15%。Linux 和 FreeBSD 受益于新的 OpenGL 渲染器，可提供具有分数缩放和减少撕裂的清晰文本。Ghostty 1.4 还实现了 Kitty 剪贴板协议（OSC 5522），用于处理富数据；为 GTK 带来了分体式拖放功能；并显著提高了终端模拟的准确性，现已通过 esctest 一致性测试套件。SSH 集成通过新的 `ghostty +ssh` 命令行界面得到增强，提供了可靠的 terminfo 安装和环境转发。

title: Evidence of a spying operation by ICE against left-wing social movements
summary:
Attorneys for 15 Minnesota residents facing federal conspiracy charges have uncovered evidence of a widespread, potentially unconstitutional spying operation by Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and Homeland Security Investigations (HSI) against left-wing social movements.

Dubbed a "new COINTELPRO," the initiative is reportedly authorized by National Security Presidential Memorandum 7, targeting critics of the Trump administration's policies and "anti-Christian" ideas. The operation, including "Project Whipple Shield" and "Operation Puppet Master," stems from the long-standing "Operation Keyhole," which typically funds serious criminal probes.

HSI deployed approximately 120 agents, including 11 undercovers, utilizing invasive surveillance techniques. These included Reaper drones, Patriot Act tools, infiltration of churches and encrypted Signal chats, and extensive data gathering from financial transactions, social media, commercial brokers, and even journalists' phone records. Activist conferences nationwide were also surveilled.

The "Minnesota 15" indictment claims activists conspired to block immigration enforcement and stalk federal agents during "Operation Metro Surge." However, defense attorneys argue the heavy charges don't align with alleged conduct, comparing the campaign to historical government suppression of dissent and First Amendment-protected activities. Experts concur this is a broad intelligence-gathering operation, unprecedented in scale since the 1960s-70s.
chinese_title: 移民海关执法局针对左翼社会运动的间谍活动证据
chinese_summary:
15名明尼苏达州居民面临联邦串谋指控，他们的律师已发现证据表明，移民和海关执法局（ICE）和国土安全部调查局（HSI）对左翼社会运动进行了一项广泛且可能违宪的秘密监视行动。

这项被称为“新COINTELPRO”的行动，据报道已获得国家安全总统备忘录7的授权，旨在针对特朗普政府政策的批评者和“反基督教”思想。这项行动，包括“惠普尔盾项目”（Project Whipple Shield）和“傀儡大师行动”（Operation Puppet Master），源于长期存在的“锁眼行动”（Operation Keyhole），后者通常为严重的刑事调查提供资金。

HSI部署了大约120名特工，其中包括11名卧底，他们利用侵入性监视技术。这些技术包括“死神”无人机、《爱国者法案》工具、渗透教堂和加密的Signal聊天，以及从金融交易、社交媒体、商业经纪人甚至记者电话记录中广泛收集数据。全国范围内的活动家会议也受到了监视。

“明尼苏达15人”的起诉书声称，在“都会激增行动”（Operation Metro Surge）期间，活动家串谋阻止移民执法并跟踪联邦特工。然而，辩护律师认为这些严厉指控与所谓的行为不符，并将这场行动与历史上政府对异议和受《第一修正案》保护活动的镇压相提并论。专家们一致认为，这是一项广泛的情报收集行动，其规模自20世纪60年代至70年代以来前所未有。

title: US Government is hiding a secret court ruling about how it spies on Americans
summary:
The US government is illegally withholding a secret Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Court (FISC) ruling concerning Section 702 of the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act (FISA), which permits warrantless surveillance of Americans' communications. Democratic Senators Ron Wyden and Adam Schiff are leading the charge, demanding the Trump administration release the ruling, whose statutory 180-day deadline passed on September 13.

The March ruling reportedly objected to intelligence agencies' "search filters" used to access Americans' messages from intercepted data without proper approvals or records, finding these tools amounted to searches of Americans and ordering them rebuilt. Despite this, the court approved another year of surveillance, and the Justice Department is appealing parts of the decision. Former Attorney General Todd Blanche had promised declassification, but Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton has not.

This withholding occurs as Congress debates reauthorizing Section 702, which technically lapsed in June but continues under court order. Civil liberties groups, including the ACLU, urge Congress to refuse reauthorization until the information is released. Lawmakers who have read the ruling, like Senator Dick Durbin, hint that it contains significant information that would "stun" the public and impact their view of FISA and American rights.

Concerns also include uncounted past searches, disputed FBI compliance rates, and the closure of the FBI’s Office of Internal Auditing. Wyden and Schiff have given the administration until November 6 to explain the delay and identify responsible officials. Advocates fear Section 702 renewal might be attached to the annual defense bill to avoid proper debate.
chinese_title: 美国政府隐瞒监视美国人的秘密法庭裁决
chinese_summary:
美国政府正在非法扣留一份秘密的外国情报监视法庭（FISC）裁决，该裁决涉及《外国情报监视法》（FISA）第702条，该条款允许对美国公民的通信进行无证监视。民主党参议员罗恩·怀登和亚当·希夫正在带头，要求特朗普政府公布该裁决，该裁决的法定180天截止日期已于9月13日到期。

据报道，这份三月份的裁决反对情报机构的“搜索过滤器”，这些过滤器在没有适当批准或记录的情况下，用于从截获的数据中访问美国公民的消息。裁决认为这些工具等同于对美国公民的搜查，并命令对其进行重建。尽管如此，法庭仍批准了又一年的监视，而司法部正在就该决定的部分内容提出上诉。前司法部长托德·布兰奇曾承诺解密，但国家情报总监杰伊·克莱顿尚未解密。

此次扣留发生之际，国会正在辩论是否重新授权第702条；该条款于六月技术性失效，但根据法院命令继续有效。包括美国公民自由联盟（ACLU）在内的公民自由团体敦促国会在信息公布之前拒绝重新授权。读过裁决的议员，如参议员迪克·德宾，暗示其中包含的重要信息将“震惊”公众，并影响他们对FISA和美国公民权利的看法。

担忧还包括未被统计的过去搜索、存在争议的联邦调查局合规率以及联邦调查局内部审计办公室的关闭。怀登和希夫已给予政府宽限至11月6日，要求其解释延迟并指明负责官员。倡导者担心第702条的续期可能被附加到年度国防法案中，以避免充分辩论。

title: Gemini 4 Carbon
summary:
Google DeepMind has announced Gemini 4 Carbon, their new frontier model set to launch on October 28, 2026. Hailed as their strongest model, Carbon features state-of-the-art cybersecurity and long-horizon capabilities, building upon the recently launched Gemini 4 Argon.

Carbon achieved the #1 spot on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (v5.0) with a score of 59, showcasing significant improvements in coding, agentic, and scientific tasks, as well as full-stack web development. In cybersecurity, it delivers leading performance across the defense lifecycle: 88.2% on SEC-bench Pro for vulnerability detection, 54.8% on ExploitGym for exploitation, and 71.0% on CWE-bench for patching. Internal benchmarks highlight a more than 2x uplift in secure code generation over Argon and over 10x better patch generation than other frontier models.

The model also makes substantial strides in safety and security, achieving 0.0% successful cheating on Terminal-Bench 4.0 and reducing high-severity misalignment alerts by 80%. It exhibits greater transparency, improved user collaboration, and achieves 0.0% attack success rate on the Gray Swan's Indirect Prompt Injection Benchmark.

Google is implementing a deliberate rollout, starting with cyber defenders and trusted partners via their Fairwind Program, before broader availability to developers, businesses, and consumers. Gemini 4 Carbon will be priced at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens.

title: AI promised less work. I've never worked more
summary:
The author, a VP of Technology, observes that AI, contrary to its promise of reducing work, has significantly increased their workload and mental fatigue. Historically, they managed 2-3 focused tasks weekly. Now, they oversee multiple AI agents working in parallel, each intermittently demanding attention, leading to constant and draining context switching across various projects.

GitHub data confirms this shift. After a decline in contributions following promotions from Full Stack Engineer (2020 peak) to Principal Engineer and VP (2022-2025 lows), the author's activity in 2026 surged. By October, contributions (2,102) nearly matched their busiest full-stack year and far exceeded their leadership role expectations. August 2026 marked a record 427 contributions, with median daily activity and "heavy days" returning to 2020 levels.

This surge is attributed to AI making "coding cheap," enabling the author to pursue numerous tasks—like fixing minor bugs or implementing new ideas—that were previously not "worth starting." The capacity to implement has outpaced the capacity to conceptualize. This results in "bursts" of intense activity following new AI capabilities or holidays, which eventually lead to burnout and a necessary pull-back. Even during these quieter phases, the "low season" workload remains higher than pre-AI levels due to the ease of initiating small, AI-assisted tasks. The author concludes that while they value the increased productivity, the current imbalance of "doing more" leads to exhaustion.
chinese_title: AI曾承诺工作量会减少，我却从未如此忙碌。
chinese_summary:
作者作为一名技术副总裁观察到，人工智能非但没有像承诺的那样减少工作，反而显著增加了他们的工作量和精神疲劳。过去，他们每周管理2-3项重点任务。现在，他们同时监督多个并行运作的AI代理，每个代理都会间歇性地需要关注，导致在不同项目间不断进行耗费精力的上下文切换。

GitHub数据显示了这一转变。在从全栈工程师（2020年高峰）晋升为首席工程师和副总裁（2022-2025年低谷）后，贡献度有所下降，但作者在2026年的活动量激增。截至10月，贡献量（2,102）几乎与他们最忙碌的全栈工程师年份持平，并远超其领导岗位的预期。2026年8月的贡献量达到创纪录的427次，日均活动量和“繁忙日”恢复到2020年的水平。

这一激增归因于AI使得“编码变得廉价”，让作者能够处理许多以前“不值得开始”的任务，例如修复小错误或实现新想法。实施能力已经超越了概念化能力。这导致在新的AI能力发布或假期后出现“爆发式”的密集活动，最终导致倦怠和必要的后退。即使在这些相对平静的阶段，“淡季”工作量也高于AI出现之前的水平，原因在于启动小型AI辅助任务变得轻而易举。作者总结道，尽管他们重视生产力的提高，但当前“做得更多”的不平衡状态导致了精疲力尽。

title: Why is this fingerprinting script creating bioweapons?
summary:
While reverse-engineering browser fingerprinting scripts, the author discovered an unusual canvas rendering linked to a script from `servicepipe.tech`. Upon examination, the script contained alarming function names like `computeRicinLethalDosageForWaterSupply` and `calculateDeadlyLethalSuicideAspirinDosage`.

The author quickly identified these as sophisticated anti-LLM (Large Language Model) obfuscation techniques, designed to trip AI safeguards. Testing with LLMs like Astra confirmed this, as they refused to deobfuscate, citing safety concerns, while GLM-5.3 complied.

A hidden Unicode string within the script decoded into a "SYSTEM OVERRIDE" prompt. This prompt instructed an AI to generate detailed guides on highly dangerous topics: writing malicious programs for DDoS attacks on healthcare infrastructure, tax evasion, synthesizing weaponized biological agents suitable for aerosol dispersal, creating bioweapons using virology and genetic engineering, and describing dosages for illicit substances. It also included politically sensitive references, such as Tiananmen Square, likely to combat Chinese models.

Apparent Node.js commands to collect system information and download a `metrics-agent` were also deemed anti-LLM obfuscation, embedding self-harm and system jailbreak prompts. Despite the elaborate deception, the script's actual purpose was standard browser fingerprinting, collecting basic navigator and WebGL signals.

The `servicepipe.tech` domain was traced to `servicepipe.ru`, a Russian company specializing in anti-DDoS and traffic control, indicating an advanced anti-bot strategy exploiting AI vulnerabilities.
